CommunityApplications.Profile:
Official Unraid templates for **Silo** — a self-hosted media streaming server for movies, shows, music and books.
Point Silo at your media shares and stream to your devices at home or away, with direct play, remuxing and hardware-accelerated transcoding handled automatically. A full web client and admin interface ship with the server, and an optional Jellyfin/Emby-compatible API lets you keep using clients such as Infuse, VidHub and Findroid.
This repository provides three templates:
- **Silo** — the media server itself - **Silo-PostgreSQL** — PostgreSQL 18 with the `pgvector` extension, pre-configured for Silo - **Silo-Redis** — Redis, pre-configured for Silo
Install **Silo-PostgreSQL** and **Silo-Redis** first, then **Silo**. Silo will not start until it can reach both.
Support is via Discord or GitHub Issues.
